LanguageData.GS_PresetsHelp: Recommended sharpens textures and improves detail on angled surfaces. Default restores the game's settings.
LanguageData.GS_RestartRequired: You will have to restart the game to apply changes!
LanguageData.GS_MipMapToolTip: This value changes how blurry textures can get depending on zoom, it is recommended to be equal or below 0.
LanguageData.GS_AnisoLevelToolTip: Set the level of anisotropic filtering, higher levels may reduce performance on older graphics cards.
LanguageData.GS_ModsToProcessLabel: {0} mods have loaded textures. Run an analysis to see results.
LanguageData.GS_CacheWarnOverflow: Your system cannot support these settings."
LanguageData.GS_CacheWarnStruggle: Your system may struggle with these settings.
LanguageData.GS_FilterModeHelp: Point keeps pixels sharp. Bilinear softens edges. Trilinear also smooths changes between texture detail levels.
LanguageData.GS_AnisotropicLevelHelp: Keeps surfaces like floors clearer when viewed at an angle. Higher levels may affect performance.
LanguageData.GS_GlobalMipmapLimitHelp: Lower resolutions reduce detail and can reduce memory use.
LanguageData.GS_EstimateNotReady: Run an analysis to see the estimate.
LanguageData.GS_UnestimatedTextureCount: {0} textures not included in the estimate
LanguageData.GS_MainMenuButton: Show Graphics Settings on the main menu
LanguageData.GS_MainMenuButtonHelp: Show or hide this shortcut on the main menu.
LanguageData.GS_MipMapBiasHelp: Move right for sharper textures. Very sharp settings can make fine details shimmer.
LanguageData.GS_MipMapBiasDescription: Adjust texture sharpness as you zoom in and out.
LanguageData.GS_PreviewHint: This is a sample image, not a game scene. Results may look different in game.
LanguageData.GS_SearchModsTip: Filter by mod name or package ID.
LanguageData.GS_ModEstimatedPayloadTooltip: Estimated texture data: {0}. This is {1} of the total estimate.
LanguageData.GS_ModNoTextureEstimateTooltip: This mod's texture sizes could not be estimated.
LanguageData.GS_AnalysisFailedStatus: Analysis stopped before it finished. Try again.
LanguageData.GS_SummaryEstimateScenario: Approximate texture data for loaded mods
LanguageData.GS_MemoryInfoVramText: Shows current graphics memory reported by the game. Driver readings can include all graphics resources used by the game. If unavailable, this shows allocations tracked by the game.
LanguageData.GS_MemoryInfoRangeText: Shows the lowest and highest readings recorded while this window is open. Readings update every two seconds.
LanguageData.GS_MemoryInfoRamText: Shows memory used by the whole game, including non-graphics data.
LanguageData.GS_MemoryInfoEstimateText: Estimates texture data for loaded mods. This is not a measured VRAM total.
LanguageData.GS_SummaryWaiting: Run an analysis to see the estimate.
LanguageData.GS_VramTrackedTotalValue: {0} tracked by the game of {1} GPU memory
LanguageData.GS_VramLowTooltip: Minimum VRAM usage recorded while this window is open
LanguageData.GS_VramPeakTooltip: Maximum VRAM usage recorded while this window is open
LanguageData.GS_VramDeviceLimitTooltip: GPU memory limit used for the bar scale: {0}
LanguageData.GS_VramDriverTooltip: Reading reported by the graphics driver. It includes GPU resources beyond mod textures.
LanguageData.GS_VramTrackedTooltip: Fallback reading of GPU allocations tracked by the game. It may miss allocations managed elsewhere.
